protocol.hypothesis: Doubling the existing failure cost from -200 to -400 (per-step failure contribution -4 to -8 after CTRL_DT) may improve early randomized-start survival without sacrificing command tracking. Factorial sampler control checks whether it rescues the prior pure-yaw sampler. No claim of a software bug in the original reward.

evaluation.note: Fixed commands, no observation noise, randomized training reset distribution. Same reset batches across policies/commands. First trial only.

screen.selection: To replace the production default, a candidate must pass its paired screen AND the same checks against baseline. If both pass, prefer penalty-only as the smaller change. If neither passes, retain original sampler and -200 cost. Supplemental diagnoses cannot override a failed gate.
screen.note: Local recipe screen, not statistical significance or hardware certification. RMSE gates use arithmetic means of nominal reports; in-place means left/right. Survival uses all six commands, which reuse reset states.

protocol.budget: Twelve new full-budget trainings: six fresh and six resumptions. Reuse twelve final control weights; no checkpoint selection or early stopping. New execution: 138240000 transitions.
limitations: Three training seeds per fresh variant, and three previously selected weak continuation chains.
Prior controls use the same training numerical path; cause labels only expose existing termination predicates. Validate evaluator parity before interpreting effects.
Both training lanes use two CPU threads; CUDA disabled. Shared-host timing is not a throughput comparison.

sequence_protocol.purpose: Supplemental continuous command transitions after fixed-command evaluation; does not override the primary screen.
sequence_protocol.note: Six consecutive 20-second segments without resetting surviving rows. First-trial survival only; later-segment errors are conditioned on surviving earlier segments. No observation noise.

implementation_audit.note: Task difference exposes the same three termination predicates; optimizer, reward for baseline, RNG calls, observations and integration unchanged. Candidate cost and sampling are isolated in task snapshots.

trajectory_parity.protocol: Training observation noise and random reset enabled; deterministic pretrained actor plus fixed small action noise, 32 rows × 1200 steps; no optimization. Covers command resampling and episode resets.

control_audit.note: Nominal-pose evaluation has no reset or observation randomization; changing its seed does not create a new trial. All previous fields except seed match exactly; termination causes are additive. These checks reuse already scheduled reports.

control_source_audit.note: Compared all 102 package Python files. Only evaluator/CLI and the behavior-preserving termination-reporting block differ; all training wrapper functions and 100 other files match byte-for-byte or AST as stated. No assertion of a full native dependency graph hash.

actuation.note: Post hoc comparison of the previously identified failed row (training seed 1, reset seed 8303, row 27/32, standing). Counts cover the same first 0.5 seconds. Commands outside the model joint range are not automatically clipped by position actuators; model joint-limit constraints are soft. This trace does not isolate a cause or establish that target clipping improves behavior.

metadata.note: Post hoc failed-row diagnosis. Forces are last integration-substep samples, not step averages or substep peaks. No training or independent acceptance evidence.

protocol.purpose: Post hoc diagnostic of the observed training-versus-deterministic-evaluation gap. Vary only sampled Gaussian actions versus policy mean; no optimization or changes to production inference/screen. Results cannot override failed primary gates.
protocol.commands: same six fixed commands as primary protocol
protocol.deterministic_controls: reuse identical weights and reset-seed reports from primary fixed-command evaluation
protocol.budget: 144 stochastic reports, 4608 first-trial instances; control initial states repeated across commands; independent training replication remains three seeds per variant.

data_note: Per-row survival, termination reasons, duration and RMSE retained. Batched return and mean velocity summarized; full raw reports remain at hashed local paths. Twelve historical training controls are not counted as new execution.
